page.layout: One page of text in a single column, right of centre; running head at top centre; page number at top left of the column. No margin notes. Right edge shows the neighbouring page (show-through, not transcribed). Digitiser's banner at the foot left out.

main_text.p: nimium hac in re adolescētia sibi studiorū impedimento indulget, nō æstimās quantū sit & commodum, et ornamentū, posse apud eruditos expeditè, propriè & perspicuè cogitata animi latinè expri mere. Quì felicitatē si quis putet sine exercitatione cōparari, stultè errat. Hortor igitur discipulos meos, qui extra meā domū habitāt, ut cū suis cōtubernalibus colloquētes tantùm Latina utantur lin gua. Iis uerò qui sunt domi meæ idem præcipio, sed hac lege & multa addita, ut si quis uernacula lin gua intra domū usus fuisse deprehēdatur, numulū soluat, ad præmiū in certaminibus uictoribus distribuendū, de quibus infrà dicemus. Eadē lege tenebuntur ij quoq;, qui alibi habitāt, quoties locuti Germanicè fuerint. Cùm aūt Orationis Latinæ initia hauriri cōueniat ex arte Grāmatica, illius præcepta posthac pueris tradā, & rursus exigā horā diurna, die Lunæ, & Martis: alijs duob. Iouis, et Veneris eadē hora explicatur. Terētij comœdias, ut habeāt exēpla purę orationis Latinæ, quæ imitari possint. Vtq; uel æmulatione cōpellātur ad repetitionē assiduā præceptorū Grāmatices, aliquot delectis ex cœtu discipulorū proponetur tēpestiuè aliqua pars carminis Vergiliani ex Bucolicis, in quo dictionum ἐτυμα, origines, flexus, structuras, ita diligēter inuestigabūt delecti illi, ut cæteris suis cōdiscipulis cōuenturis post cœnā die Mercurij, et profectum

page.notes: Several words are set with long-s and ligature forms, read as printed. Printed Greek word "ἐτυμα" and the "ta" of the Greek in the line "dictionum" read with reasonable confidence; the Greek accent on "ἐτυμα" is doubtful. Some abbreviations and superscript letters (e.g. "Iouis", "lin gua") follow the scan and may contain minor errors. Marginal note-free page; two faint marks in the left margin are not text.
